reviews.text: Rodrigo is an excellent professional! Top-notch service! I recommend him!

I’m so happy to have found Can D’Oro and Rodrigo! I had taken my Maltese Shih Tzu to another groomer and they gave her the equivalent of a buzz cut. Needless to say, I was very particular about finding someone I could trust, and Rodrigo has been wonderful.

He is meticulous, listens to exactly what I want, and takes such care with my pup. His studio is clean and comfortable, and I always feel like she is in good hands. His prices are very reasonable, especially considering the quality of his work.

I couldn’t be happier with the way she looks after every visit. Rodrigo is truly exceptional at what he does, and I highly recommend Can D’Oro to anyone looking for a groomer who genuinely cares about both the dogs and their owners.

I came here on a recommendation, but the reality is that my experience was not positive. From the day I booked the grooming appointment until the day of the service, they were very unprofessional.
Even so, I accepted and gave them the opportunity to see your work.
The five-hour service wasn't cheap, and in the end, my dog ​​came home with an incomplete, poorly executed job and cuts on his skin.
I do not recommend them, and it's always best to ask beforehand if they have experience with your dog's breed.
One of the best groomers in Portugal, I recommend him 100%, an excellent professional with a wonderful salon.

From our very first visit, we knew we had found the right person to take care of our little Macau.

Rodrigo's care, attention, dedication, and affection truly make all the difference. It's clear he genuinely loves animals and is concerned with every detail, which puts us completely at ease.

We only recently started going there, but one thing is certain: we're not changing. Thank you for taking such good care of our Macau. I recommend him 100%.
Having winning dogs in the show ring is having an excellent groomer behind them and Candoro is that. Professional in every way and excellence is their top priority.

As a mommy to this wonderful breed grooming is só important and I could not ask for a more professional then Candor. I thank you for always making them look there best and I would recommend them wholeheartedly to anyone that is looking for a specialist in the breed

I've been grooming my Chinese Crested Powderpuff dog for 7 years, and I do an excellent job.
I'm knowledgeable about different coat types and techniques for each dog... I highly recommend him, as I have been doing for many years.
Rodrigo has a wealth of experience, talent, and sensitivity. We LOVED the haircut he gave our very spoiled Maltipoo. We will be back on every trip. Thank you so much, Rodrigo!!! Eliana
Top place! Rodrigo is an amazing groomer. Benjy always looks incredible and is treated with so much care and love. Highly recommend!
Daisy (a cocker spaniel) is a client and always leaves with a flawless haircut, and Rodrigo is an excellent professional!

He is one of the best pet groomers in Portugal, guaranteed!
Excellent professionalism and dedication combined with immense tenderness towards all our beloved four-legged friends!
Rodrigo is super nice to my dog, he always tries to find time when I need him, and I really like how he trims Kiko's fur. I recommend him.

Absolutely amazing! Rodrigo is so kind, patient, and caring with my dog from start to finish. My dog usually does not like people, so I’m always extra careful about who I leave him with, but he stays with Rodrigo very happy and comfortable, which says everything. He always comes back looking adorable, smelling fantastic, and clearly feeling relaxed and well cared for. You can tell Rodrigo truly loves animals and takes pride in his work. The grooming is always done beautifully, with great attention to detail, and the whole experience is professional and stress-free. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my dog — highly recommend!
The best groomer in Lisbon!
Rodrigo is professional, lovely, calm, gentle, nice, extremely polite a real gentleman. Athena and Teodora loves him, we too. The best groom stylist in Lisbon.
A fantastic place!
Rodrigo is the absolute best groomer in Lisbon. We’ve been going to him for years and he is very skilled and gentle. I wouldn’t trust Pearl with anyone else.

Rodrigo is an amazing groomer — patient, caring, and incredibly skilled. Our Miniature Schnauzer always feels safe and relaxed with him, and she comes out looking absolutely perfect every single time.
We’re really grateful to have found Rodrigo. Highly recommend!
I love it!!!! Impeccable grooming!!!
Rodrigo is the most caring and skilled professional Charlie has been to. We keep coming as I’m sure we’d never find a better groomer. I couldn’t recommend Rodrigo enough!

I can only recommend Rodrigo, for his incredible dedication that makes him an outstanding professional. The space is welcoming, and my Joe is completely satisfied!
Thank you for your professionalism.

We recently started taking our dog Nyx to Rodrigo's salon and quickly became fans. Rodrigo is extremely friendly, attentive, and demonstrates enormous talent as a groomer.

Something that puts us especially at ease is Nyx's body language when we leave her there. Although she doesn't love going to the grooming salon—as is common with many dogs—it's clear that she feels more comfortable with Rodrigo. This contrasts with other experiences we've had previously, where we suspect that discomfort or pain during brushing made her apprehensive.

Nyx is a Portuguese Water Dog, with a more demanding coat, and yet Rodrigo handles it impeccably.

We highly recommend his work!
